description: A library barrel file that consolidates exports of main widgets, models, and utility components for the Flutter frontend of a Tic Tac Toe game. This file simplifies imports elsewhere in the project by exposing key classes and widgets like App, MyApp, GameState, BoardGrid, ResetControls, and ScoreBar.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application widget initializing the Flutter app.

classes.name: GameHomePage
classes.description: Widget representing the home page for the game, possibly containing the game grid and controls.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Flutter application, setting up theme and routing.

classes.name: GameState
classes.description: Model class representing the current state of the game, including positions and player turns.

classes.name: BoardGrid
classes.description: Widget displaying the Tic Tac Toe grid.

classes.name: ResetControls
classes.description: Widget for resetting the game, likely a button.

classes.name: ScoreBar
classes.description: Widget showing the current scores or status.
